subject.title: feat(control-ui): selection popup with More details and Ask in side chat via /btw

question: Should the Control UI adopt this selection-popup interaction and its implicit “More details” prompt as a first-party chat feature after the draft-loss defect and proof gap are resolved?
rationale: The code can be reviewed mechanically, but choosing this permanent visible interaction and prompt behavior requires product intent; the protected `maintainer` label reinforces that this PR must remain open for explicit human handling.

options.title: Adopt after fixes
options.body: Land the full interaction after preserving existing drafts and adding inspectable current-head behavior proof.

options.title: Keep pending feedback only
options.body: Retain the general `/btw` pending and error card improvements while omitting the selection popup actions.

options.title: Decline the popup
options.body: Keep manual `/btw` entry as the supported Control UI workflow and close the linked feature direction.

recommendation.title: Adopt after fixes
recommendation.body: Land the full interaction after preserving existing drafts and adding inspectable current-head behavior proof.
